instrument: `overrides` SHAPE SPLIT and PRICING — NAMING versus MECHANISM, in the gate's own columns
scope: per PROJECT (the repository a file belongs to) — the gate's default

reading.split: ownFileDeclaresLeaf = a TRUE row the resolver failed to bind (the overriding class declares the member in the same file) · projectDeclaresLeafElsewhere = the member exists on another declaration in the project · NOTHING-DECLARES-IT = a WRONG row, not a resolution failure (clause 1).
reading.pricing: asEmitted is the gate's columns for the target as written; onLeaf is the same for the LAST dotted segment. Both columns are reported, because a fix that turns unresolved into ambiguous has moved the problem rather than solved it.
